### Observed differences

- In the later window, activities A27, A36, A37, A42 and A43 appear in about half of traces instead of every trace (participation drops from 100% to about 50%); A06 drops from about 32% to about 10%. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006]
- A25's outgoing transitions change: before it went to A42, A36, A43 and A37 (each about 20–27%) and almost never to A28; after it goes to A28 in about 96% of its transitions. [DIR003]
- A26's successor changes: before it went to A27 in about 98% of transitions; after it goes to A27 in about 49% and the rest is spread over A37, A43, A36 and A42. [DIR004]
- A36, A37, A42 and A43 no longer go to A28 (before about 21–24% each, after about 0–1%) and instead go to A31 (about 22–28%). [DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008]
- When A36, A37, A42 and A43 occur, they appear later in the trace (mean position from about 0.40 to about 0.58), while A28 appears earlier (mean from about 0.47 to about 0.39). [POS007, POS008, POS009, POS010, POS005]
- A25 and A28 become adjacent: before they were 5 steps apart in about 99% of pairs, after they are 1 step apart in about 97%. [LAG002]
- A25 used to co-occur with A27, A36, A37, A42 and A43 in every trace, with A25 before them; after, A25 occurs alone in about half the traces, and when it co-occurs it is still before them. [REL012, REL013, REL014, REL015, REL016]
- A26 used to be preceded by A36, A37, A42 and A43 (about 97–99% of pairs); after, when both occur, A26 precedes them (about 49%) or A26 occurs alone. [REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021]
- A28 used to be preceded by A36, A37, A42 and A43; after, A28 precedes them. [REL030, REL031, REL032, REL033]
- A31 now appears as a successor of A36, A37, A42 and A43, and when both occur, those activities still precede A31. [DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, REL034, REL035, REL036, REL037]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a structural change in which the path from A25 to A28 no longer passes through A36, A37, A42 and A43. In the later window, A25 goes directly to A28, while those intermediate activities now lead to A31 and occur in only about half of cases. This is supported directly by the successor changes (A25→A28, and A36/A37/A42/A43→A31), the lag change between A25 and A28, and the reversals of order between A26/A28 and the A36/A37/A42/A43 group. The number of consistent indicators is far above what an unchanged process would produce by chance. A competing explanation that cannot be fully ruled out is that some of the participation drop reflects sampling differences in variant frequencies, but the direct successor and order changes are not explained by that alone. [DIR003, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, LAG002, REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021, REL030, REL031, REL032, REL033]
